name: The Kitchen Threshold Marks
body:
Every couple's anniversary carved into the wooden doorframe of the kitchen entrance — date, initials, and a tiny symbol that represents them. BRYN AND TORIE'S IS FIRST, HIGHEST UP. Isolde and Mikaela's is newest, still pale where the wood hasn't darkened yet.

ALICE CARVED THEM ALL with her kitchen knife, because she insisted nobody else's handwriting was precise enough. LUNA CORRECTED TWO OF THEM WITH A PEN. Nobody talks about it.
